title: 36 Hours in Ann Arbor, Mich.
abstract: An abundance of cultural opportunities from classical dance to bluegrass, combined with the football season, makes fall an ideal time to visit this ultimate college town.

title: 36 Hours in Ann Arbor
abstract: The town is a mix of restaurants, bars, boutiques, art-house movie theaters and world-class art museums.

title: 36 Hours in Quebec City
abstract: Quebec is a city of delightfully stark, yet virtually seamless contrasts.

title: 36 Hours in Quebec City
abstract: One of the oldest cities in North America, Quebec City, with its revitalized parks and gleaming cultural centers, has emerged from the long shadow of its popular neighbor, Montreal.

title: 36 Hours in Albuquerque
abstract: Taking in trolley tours, empanadas and grand views of the Sandias in New Mexico’s biggest city.

title: 36 Hours in Albuquerque
abstract: With new hotels, a revived downtown, and miles of bike trails, New Mexico’s largest city has come into its own.

title: 36 Hours in Cape Town
abstract: Despite the grinding poverty on its outskirts, urban revival continues in the city center.

title: 36 Hours in Cape Town
abstract: With urban revival continuing in parts of the city after the 2010 World Cup, Cape Town is still a place where nature dazzles, and history lingers.
